findings.motion: Assembly Floor, SB 1174 Min Senate Third Reading
findings.note: SB 1174 (Min, 2024) would prohibit a local government from requiring a person to present identification to vote or submit a ballot at a polling place, vote center or other ballot location, as specified; chaptered 2024-09-29. Digital Democracy lists Diane Papan among the 57 'For' votes on the Assembly floor (57 for, 16 against).
